instruction: Candid portrait photograph, medium close-up. Two men stand close together outdoors against a red brick wall. On the left, the fair-skinned man with light brown hair and a beard in a teal t-shirt and pinkish-grey open shirt (R2) smiles warmly while looking to the right. On the right, the Black man in the light blue open shirt over a white t-shirt (R1) looks back at him with a gentle smile. The tight framing captures their friendly, smiling interaction under bright, natural daylight, highlighting the warm red tones of the brick background.
